svg.title: Awesome Switch Recomp: your own Switch games, recompiled to run natively on iPhone, Mac, PC, Steam Deck and Android
svg.desc: Unofficial list of 60 Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 static recompilation projects and native ports. Bring your own copy: no ROMs, no keys. Example rows: nxnative for iPhone and Mac; Hookshot, Ocarina of Time, for PC; ultratears, Tears of the Kingdom, for Steam Deck; BOTWRecompAndroid, Breath of the Wild, for Android.
